_comment: Weekly lead-in for summary.plain (the grandmother layer). generate.mjs weeklyOpener() compares this week's score/band to the most recent prior snapshot in historical.json and prepends one of these, ahead of the transition-agnostic monthly 'standing' read. Slots: {score} {max} {prior} {band}. {band} = plain-language regime word (PLAIN_BAND in generate.mjs). Shown only when a genuine prior snapshot exists; the monthly read stands alone otherwise. Keep it a couple of words — the week is the 'what's new', the month is the substance.

moveUp.en: The score firmed a little this week, from {prior} to {score} of {max}.
moveUp.pt-BR: A pontuação se firmou um pouco nesta semana, de {prior} para {score} de {max}.
moveUp.es: La puntuación mejoró un poco esta semana, de {prior} a {score} de {max}.
moveUp.de: Der Wert festigte sich diese Woche etwas, von {prior} auf {score} von {max}.

moveDown.en: The score eased a little this week, from {prior} to {score} of {max}.
moveDown.pt-BR: A pontuação cedeu um pouco nesta semana, de {prior} para {score} de {max}.
moveDown.es: La puntuación cedió un poco esta semana, de {prior} a {score} de {max}.
moveDown.de: Der Wert gab diese Woche etwas nach, von {prior} auf {score} von {max}.

bandUp.en: This week the read stepped up a level, from {prior} to {score} of {max}.
bandUp.pt-BR: Nesta semana a leitura subiu um nível, de {prior} para {score} de {max}.
bandUp.es: Esta semana la lectura subió un nivel, de {prior} a {score} de {max}.
bandUp.de: Diese Woche rückte die Bewertung eine Stufe höher, von {prior} auf {score} von {max}.

bandDown.en: This week the read stepped down a level, from {prior} to {score} of {max}.
bandDown.pt-BR: Nesta semana a leitura desceu um nível, de {prior} para {score} de {max}.
bandDown.es: Esta semana la lectura bajó un nivel, de {prior} a {score} de {max}.
bandDown.de: Diese Woche rückte die Bewertung eine Stufe tiefer, von {prior} auf {score} von {max}.
